behaviors.assignee-choices: Opening the Assignee filter shows Anyone, each person, and Unassigned with task counts.
behaviors.search-assignees: Typing in Find a person narrows the assignee choices.
behaviors.filter-by-person: Selecting a person shows only their tasks that match the selected status and updates the task count.
behaviors.filter-unassigned: Selecting Unassigned shows only tasks with no assignee.
behaviors.assignee-empty-state: Selecting Ana Lima shows a message that nothing is assigned to her yet and offers Clear filters.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear filters resets both filters and restores the full task list.

history.notes: The tour uses the supplied seed data and scopes task locators to board cards. The status control is scoped to the toolbar because task cards also contain status selects.
